sampling_design.method: Explicit staged confirmation, not 44 newly independent draws:34 retained non-CC100/non-quarantined documents from independent round3,9 retained documents from a10-document fresh topup,then1new wikisource document after whole-source wikiquote quarantine. Whole-source/exact reviewed-row deletions did not modify any retained text.

limitations: Agent review, not independent native-speaker approval or an exhaustive corpus quality assessment.
The retained44 are a documented staged review set; adaptive exclusions mean their aggregate verdict proportions must not be used as an unbiased corpus error-rate estimate.
Long texts were inspected only in recorded windows.

Residual coherent teaser archives, recommendation/comment tails, fragments, raw small markup, isolated grammar errors, historical OCR/punctuation damage and mixed-script or bibliographic fragments remain.

No new severe pervasive malformed translation, dominant UI-only text or extreme syllable fragmentation was observed in the recorded final retained windows; this does not establish absence corpus-wide.
All text/split/metadata must remain unchanged in the strict-subset generation. Actual producer and independent lineage validation are still required before tokenizer training.
Books remain a minor train-only source after contamination quarantine; no book-specific held-out quality estimate is asserted.
No model behavior, factual accuracy, medical/legal advice quality or independent copyright clearance is certified by this language/extraction spot-check.
